description: Source code for the Job Card doctype in ERPNext manufacturing module, defining the JobCard class with validation, scheduling, and related functions for manufacturing job cards.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Validation error for overlapping job card time logs.

classes.name: OperationMismatchError
classes.description: Validation error for mismatched operation IDs.

classes.name: OperationSequenceError
classes.description: Validation error for incorrect operation sequence.

classes.name: JobCardCancelError
classes.description: Validation error for job card cancellation issues.

classes.name: JobCard
classes.description: Main class representing a manufacturing job card with methods for validation, scheduling, and updating related documents.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads additional data when the job card is loaded, such as excess transfer settings and work order status.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the job card before submission.

methods.name: set_sub_operations
methods.description: Sets sub-operations related to the main operation.

methods.name: validate_time_logs
methods.description: Validates the time logs for overlaps and correctness.

methods.name: get_overlap_for
methods.description: Checks for overlapping time logs for the job card.

methods.name: schedule_time_logs
methods.description: Schedules time logs considering workstation availability.

methods.name: validate_overlap_for_workstation
methods.description: Validates and adjusts time logs for workstation overlaps.

methods.name: check_workstation_time
methods.description: Checks and adjusts planned times based on workstation working hours.

methods.name: add_time_log
methods.description: Adds a new time log entry to the job card.

methods.name: add_start_time_log
methods.description: Adds a start time log entry.

methods.name: set_employees
methods.description: Assigns employees to the job card.

methods.name: reset_timer_value
methods.description: Resets timer-related fields.

methods.name: update_sub_operation_status
methods.description: Updates the status of sub-operations based on time logs.

methods.name: update_time_logs
methods.description: Updates time logs with new timing information.

methods.name: get_required_items
methods.description: Fetches required raw materials for the job card based on the work order.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Actions to perform when the job card is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Actions to perform when the job card is canceled.

methods.name: validate_transfer_qty
methods.description: Validates if transfer quantities are correct.

methods.name: validate_job_card
methods.description: Validates the job card's status and data before submission.

methods.name: update_work_order
methods.description: Updates related work order data based on the job card.

methods.name: update_corrective_in_work_order
methods.description: Updates work order with corrective operation costs.

methods.name: validate_produced_quantity
methods.description: Ensures produced quantity matches expected.

methods.name: update_work_order_data
methods.description: Updates work order operation data with actuals.

methods.name: get_current_operation_data
methods.description: Retrieves current operation data for the work order.

methods.name: set_transferred_qty_in_job_card
methods.description: Sets transferred quantity for raw materials.

methods.name: set_transferred_qty
methods.description: Calculates and sets total transferred quantity.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the job card based on current data.

methods.name: validate_operation_id
methods.description: Validates that the operation ID belongs to the work order.

methods.name: validate_sequence_id
methods.description: Validates the sequence of operations in the work order.

methods.name: validate_work_order
methods.description: Checks if the work order is closed before allowing modifications.

methods.name: is_work_order_closed
methods.description: Returns True if the associated work order is closed.
